correctness.rationale: For a compactly supported invariant measure, the generator annihilates one-coordinate test functions. Testing functions of \(z\), \(y\), and \(x\) gives the three conditional expectations. Conditional residual orthogonality then gives the two nontrivial variance Pythagoras identities, while \(\dot z=-4(x-1/4)\) gives the third. Equality in the mean floor forces zero \(x\)-variance, then zero \(y\)-variance, and invariance of the support forces the unique equilibrium value of \(z\). The included symbolic checker independently confirms the equilibrium and algebraic channel identities.

value.rationale: The result supplies a parameter-independent calibration across an entire three-parameter chaotic family: vertical derivative energy determines the stationary mean \(\mathbb E[y]\) exactly, the equilibrium is the unique minimizer of that mean, and two further conditional laws yield exact fluctuation decompositions. These identities can distinguish equilibrium from any compact recurrent non-equilibrium regime and provide exact consistency checks for periodic/chaotic computations without requiring a downstream theorem. The object and invariant are natural because the perturbation changes only the \(x\)-channel while the \(y\)-relaxation and \(z\)-forcing channels remain fixed.
